Business Opportunities .....

For businesses of every size and ambition, Al Maskaan Village presents meticulously designed retail and office units tailored to meet diverse needs.

1. Retail Spaces
 Discover vibrant opportunities within our retail spaces:

  • Lease contemporary and well-maintained shops strategically located in high-traffic areas.
  • Tap into a pre-established customer base comprised of residents and visitors.
  • Immerse yourself in a supportive environment within our lively community.

Whether you’re launching a new venture or managing an established company, our diverse array of rental spaces caters to your distinct needs and growth aspirations. Our offerings range from 43.15 m² to 90.66 m², providing versatile solutions to elevate your business operations.

 

Specific Spaces for Financial Institutions, Restaurants, and Supermarkets

Tailoring our spaces to accommodate all types of businesses, we have dedicated areas for specific needs.

For financial services, our units of 54.55 m² and 111.03 m² offer ideal spaces for exchange stores, ensuring both security and convenience. Additionally, our 24.87 m² ATM space serves as a strategic access point for financial transactions. If you’re envisioning a comprehensive bank branch, our substantial 244.21 m² space provides an excellent location.

On the culinary front, we present a 90.37 m² cafe unit, creating an inviting atmosphere for customers. Alternatively, for those aiming to establish a successful restaurant experience, our 121.98 m² unit offers ample space for culinary creativity.

Lastly, our 471 m² supermarket space provides a haven for a diverse range of groceries and household essentials, meeting the needs of the local community.

2. Office Spaces
 Whether you run a small startup, a medium-sized enterprise, or a larger corporation, you can elevate your productivity by choosing Al Maskaan Village. Our extensive selection of office units offers:

  • Contemporary and Polished Office Environment: Immerse yourself in work that combines style and comfort with our contemporary office accommodations, tailored to suit businesses of all sizes.
  • Adaptable Workspaces: Easily adapt our office spaces to match your team size and work arrangements, fostering collaboration and enhancing overall productivity.
  • Varied Office Selection: Explore a variety of units, ranging from 98.4 m² to 552.58 m², to discover the perfect fit for your team’s needs.

Prepared to join our dynamic community and achieve your business aspirations?

Dr. Thomas Alexander

Founder and Chairman

Dr. Thomas Alexander has been instrumental in propelling the company to its current stature. Under his leadership, the company has flourished, boasting approximately 6,000 employees and an order book surpassing USD 1 billion. Its operations and projects extend across the Sultanate of Oman, reflecting Dr. Alexander’s strategic vision and effective management.

With a career spanning over three decades, Dr. Alexander has been a driving force in the delivery of engineering and construction services in Oman. His contributions have significantly impacted the country’s infrastructure development, evidenced by a diverse portfolio of landmark projects across various industries. Dr. Alexander’s commitment to excellence and innovation has solidified Al Adrak’s reputation as a trusted partner in Oman’s growth journey.

Dr. Aadil Alexander

Executive Director

Dr. Aadil Alexander spearheads strategic asset management initiatives at Al Adrak Group. He aligns asset expansion with business growth while empowering teams to meticulously monitor efficiency. He leads data collection and analysis to optimize asset utilization, ensuring resources are deployed effectively for enhanced project outcomes.

Recognizing the importance of proactive maintenance, Dr. Alexander implements preventive measures to extend equipment lifespan and minimize downtime. His strategic foresight and commitment to operational excellence are instrumental in Al Adrak’s competitive edge and continued success.

Riyas Mohamed

Chief Executive Officer

Riyas Mohamed leads Al Adrak Group’s strategic direction, formulating and executing plans to achieve organizational goals. With a deep understanding of the company’s vision, he guides and aligns departments, fostering a unified approach. He meticulously manages daily operations, including resource allocation, staffing, and coordination, maximizing efficiency and effectiveness.

His hands-on approach ensures smooth operations and optimal performance, while his adept communication and collaborative spirit build trust with stakeholders, driving mutually beneficial partnerships that underpin the company’s success. Riyas Mohamed’s strategic leadership, operational acumen, and stakeholder engagement are integral to Al Adrak’s continued growth.

Richard Sequeira

DGM, Facility Management

Additionally, he leads Trufud, the company’s agricultural and aquaponics arm, spearheading initiatives that enhance Oman’s food security and promote sustainable practices. He also manages Al Maskaan Village, providing a comfortable living environment for residents. Richard Sequeira’s diverse contributions underscore his commitment to excellence and his significant role in advancing Al Adrak Group’s goals.

Rajan Prabhakaran

DGM, Technical

Rajan Prabhakaran oversees the technical intricacies of Al Adrak Group projects. With over two decades of experience in Oman and India, he brings invaluable expertise. He meticulously navigates project complexities, ensuring adherence to quality standards and optimal execution.

His extensive knowledge allows him to anticipate challenges and devise innovative solutions, driving project success and client satisfaction. Rajan Prabhakaran’s steadfast commitment to excellence and profound understanding of technical nuances play a pivotal role in enhancing Al Adrak Group’s reputation for delivering exceptional results.

Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: http://webinprogress.me/almaskan.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.
